Fire Damage is one of the Damage Types, it is mitigated by Fire Protection, Elemental Protection, and Block Protection.

- 1 Known Modifiers

- 1.1 Character Stats

- 1.2 Affixes

- 2 List of Fire Damage Skills

- 2.1 NPC

- 3 See Also

## Known Modifiers[]

### Character Stats[]

- Increased Fire Damage

- Increased Elemental Damage

- Attunement (as a result of increasing elemental damage)

### Affixes[]

- Added Melee Fire Damage (only effects Melee Attack Skills)

- Increased Fire Damage

### Equipment Implicits[]

- Burning Branch provides added melee fire damage

- Ruby Wand and its variants provide added fire damage to spells

- Mountain Axe provides added melee fire damage

- Ruby Ring provides increased fire damage
